messages:
sam.support: Heads-up - Tenant 'marlin' onboarding hit a spike of 429s during dataset ingest. AM flagged because renewal convo in 6 days. :warning:
leah.cs: thanks. can you paste one sample error and the traffic pattern? hosted or dedicated?
sam.support: Hosted. burst ~300 reqs/min from their ingestion job. sample: 
```
HTTP 429 Too Many Requests
{"error":"concurrency_limit_exceeded", "tenant_id":"acct-marlin", "route":"/v1/embeddings"}
```
we also saw SDK retries piling up and a couple of 504s.
matt.eng: likely per-tenant concurrency default + sudden burst. short mitigation: enable a temporary quota bump + enable per-tenant burst pooling, or route heavy imports to the bulk-upload path that has higher parallelism. ops can we apply override?
ops-bot: Received override request for acct-marlin. Please confirm parameters.
sam.support: please apply concurrency=60, burst=true, route bulk-path for uploads.
ops-bot: Applied override change id q-2026-09-01-03 for acct-marlin (concurrency=60, burst=on, route=bulk-upload).
sam.support: immediate telemetry: 429s dropped from 21% -> ~0.8%, 504s rare. p95 latency improved 2.4s -> 700ms.
leah.cs: good. CS comms plan (short): 1) immediate note w/ apology + transparent mitigation + owner contact, 2) schedule 30m tech sync w/ eng+support in 24h, 3) offer 1-week extension + exec touch if concerned, 4) postmortem and new playbook for bulk imports. leah to draft.
yvonne.am: I can handle renewal conversation and proposed credit. need cost impact estimate for bump.
matt.eng: RCA bullets for customer doc: - Cause: ingestion burst exceeded per-tenant concurrency, causing queueing and worker timeouts. - Temp mitigation: quota override + route to bulk-upload path. - Next steps: add tenant-aware autoscaler, increase default for bulk route, and SDK client-side backoff guidelines.
leah.cs: owners: CS (leah) send customer note + invite; Support (sam) confirm override + monitor; Eng (matt) provide RCA draft within 48h; AM (yvonne) handle credit proposal; Ops keep override until eng confirms permanent fix.
sam.support: meeting scheduled 2026-09-02 10:00 UTC, invites sent to customer + AM + eng.
incident-bot: Severity label set: P1 (renewal-watch)
leah.cs: adding feedback link to invite: https://forms.redwood/marlin-onboard-feedback
sam.support: customer replied: "Thanks - appreciate quick response. We need written playbook before scaling prod." tagged AM + eng.
yvonne.am: noted. I'll prepare exec summary and propose a 7-day extension or credit.
matt.eng: will post RCA draft here by EOD tomorrow.
ops-bot: Retention note: q-2026-09-01-03 retained until confirmed resolved.
leah.cs: thanks all. CS will send the note now and close after RCA + postmortem + feedback captured. :white_check_mark:
